scope: Two unarmed walking contact poses derived from the existing project interpretation of Decker; no previously refused image generation was retried.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE individual transparent-background character sprite for a 2D side-view adventure game, the first contact pose of an unarmed walk.
Input image: the provided image is the exact identity, outfit, proportions, surface detail and rendering reference for the project's interpretation of Alan Decker.
Primary request: create a new full-body walking pose of this SAME man, facing screen-right. Frame A: the leg nearest the camera reaches forwards to the right, heel just touching the ground; the far leg extends behind to the left with its heel lifted. The far arm swings forwards and the near arm swings gently backwards. Natural restrained walking, hands empty and relaxed. Head upright looking right.
Keep the face, short dark wavy hair, stubble, brown weathered field jacket over dark charcoal shirt, dark cargo trousers, brown belt, diagonal messenger-bag strap, hip pouch and heavy boots closely consistent with the reference. Maintain the same realistic illustrated game-sprite finish, muted brown/charcoal palette, sharp material detail, viewpoint and lighting. Keep head and torso approximately at the same height as the reference; move the limbs to show the walk.
Composition: one character, complete from hair to boot soles, centered in a 1024x1536 portrait canvas with comfortable transparent margin on all sides. Feet on a single horizontal ground line near the bottom, no cropped limbs.
Background: genuine transparent RGBA; isolated character only. Do not paint a background, glow, floor, dust, ground shadow, labels, caption, duplicate character, turnaround or sprite sheet.
No new weapons, no extra accessories, no redesign. This is one walk frame, not an animation strip.
